description: Improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts in an application using Flask could lead to brute-force attacks.
fix: Implement robust rate limiting and account lockout mechanisms for authentication endpoints.

description: A JWT issuer validation bypass in an application using Flask allows complete user impersonation.
fix: Ensure strict validation of JWT issuer claims in all authentication processes.

description: An application using Flask ships with authentication disabled by default, allowing unauthenticated workflow execution.
fix: Enable and enforce authentication for all API endpoints, especially on legacy or default configurations.

description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in a Flask application can escalate to Remote Code Execution.
fix: Sanitize all user-controlled input before rendering it in HTML to prevent XSS.

description: A CSRF exemption mechanism in a Flask application can be primed by anonymous requests.
fix: Ensure all state-changing operations are protected by CSRF tokens, regardless of user authentication status.

description: A weak JWT secret allows full account takeover via token forgery in applications using PyJWT.
fix: Use strong, randomly generated secrets for JWT signing and ensure they are securely managed.

description: A hardcoded JWT signing secret in an application using PyJWT allows authentication bypass.
fix: Replace hardcoded JWT signing secrets with securely retrieved environment variables or a secret management system.

description: PyJWT accepts unknown `crit` header extensions, which can lead to security bypasses.
fix: Update PyJWT to version 2.8.0 or newer to properly handle `crit` header extensions.

description: Unauthorized access to an API can lead to API token signing key leakage, impacting PyJWT security.
fix: Implement strict access controls and authentication for APIs to prevent unauthorized key exposure.

description: PyJWT v2.10.1 contains weak encryption vulnerabilities.
fix: Upgrade PyJWT to a version patched against weak encryption issues, ideally the latest stable release.

description: Authlib's OIDC Implicit/Hybrid Authorization flow is vulnerable to an open redirect when used with requests.
fix: Ensure all redirect URLs are strictly validated against a whitelist of allowed domains.

description: UltraJSON has a memory leak in `ujson.dump()` when a write failure occurs, potentially impacting applications using requests.
fix: Ensure proper error handling for `ujson.dump()` operations to prevent resource leaks, and upgrade UltraJSON.

description: A Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in a CORS proxy middleware, which can be exploited using requests.
fix: Implement strict validation and whitelisting of URLs accessed via the CORS proxy to prevent SSRF.

description: Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerabilities exist in several underlying management services when processing requests.
fix: Ensure proper input validation and bounds checking for all data buffers in underlying services, and upgrade relevant components.
